name: Analytics Database Schema
description: Production schema configuration for analytics and reporting database

user_events.create_sql: CREATE TABLE user_events (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT, event_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, event_category VARCHAR(50), event_data JSON, session_id VARCHAR(128), ip_address VARCHAR(45), user_agent TEXT, referrer VARCHAR(500), page_url VARCHAR(500), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_user_id (user_id), INDEX idx_event_type (event_type), INDEX idx_event_category (event_category), INDEX idx_created_at (created_at))

page_analytics.description: Website page view analytics and performance
page_analytics.create_sql: CREATE TABLE page_analytics (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT, page_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, page_title VARCHAR(200), referrer VARCHAR(500), session_id VARCHAR(128), duration_seconds INT, bounce_rate DECIMAL(5,2), load_time_ms INT, device_type VARCHAR(50), browser VARCHAR(100), os VARCHAR(100), screen_resolution VARCHAR(20), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_user_id (user_id), INDEX idx_page_url (page_url), INDEX idx_device_type (device_type), INDEX idx_created_at (created_at))

system_metrics.create_sql: CREATE TABLE system_metrics (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, metric_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, metric_value DECIMAL(15,4), metric_unit VARCHAR(20), metric_category VARCHAR(50), server_name VARCHAR(100), context_data JSON, recorded_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_metric_name (metric_name), INDEX idx_metric_category (metric_category), INDEX idx_server_name (server_name), INDEX idx_recorded_at (recorded_at))

analytics_reports.create_sql: CREATE TABLE analytics_reports (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, report_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, report_type VARCHAR(50), report_category VARCHAR(50), parameters JSON, generated_by INT, file_path VARCHAR(500), file_size INT, status ENUM('pending', 'completed', 'failed') DEFAULT 'pending', created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_report_type (report_type), INDEX idx_report_category (report_category), INDEX idx_status (status), INDEX idx_created_at (created_at))

conversion_tracking.create_sql: CREATE TABLE conversion_tracking (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT, session_id VARCHAR(128), goal_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, goal_value DECIMAL(10,2), conversion_step INT, funnel_stage VARCHAR(50), source_campaign VARCHAR(100), source_medium VARCHAR(50), source_channel VARCHAR(50), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_user_id (user_id), INDEX idx_goal_name (goal_name), INDEX idx_funnel_stage (funnel_stage), INDEX idx_source_channel (source_channel), INDEX idx_created_at (created_at))
